note: Owner-curated Redux section copy. Steps come from README.md and docs/INSTALL.md. Option labels are checked against cmd/ultimav/audio_settings_dialog_rendering.go at build time.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Get the archive for macOS, Windows or Linux from the releases page. Check it against SHA256SUMS and extract all of it.

steps.title: Bring the original
steps.text: You need the complete MS-DOS PC game folder, such as the GOG edition. The Amiga, Atari ST, Commodore 64 and Apple II versions use different files.

steps.title: Run it
steps.text: Start ultimav. First-run setup looks for your game folder, or tells you where to copy it.

steps.title: Bring a save (optional)
steps.text: The title menu imports SAVED.GAM and SAVED.OOL from your game folder. A converter handles saves kept elsewhere.

options.label: Repeated Monster Division
options.effect: On: a Slime or Gargoyle that survives can divide again and again, as in the original. Off: each divides once, and its child never does.

options.label: Remember Hidden Dungeon Discoveries
options.effect: On: hidden doors and pits you find stay found. Off: they are hidden again on your next visit.

options.label: Show Subdued Unlit Dungeons
options.effect: On: with no light you still make out dim walls and passages, but nothing is lit. Off: no light, no view, as in the original.

options.label: Batch Merchant Theft
options.effect: On: when gold goes missing in a shop, it happens once for the whole purchase. Off: as in the original, once for each item, bundle or patient, which can cut a purchase short.

options.label: Smooth Surface Movement
options.effect: On: the map glides as you walk, ride, fly or sail. Only the look changes; play, battles and dungeons run as before.

options.label: Hidden Enemy Turns
options.effect: On: an enemy you cannot see (invisible, under an arch or in the dark) still takes its place in Turn Order, as ??? unseen. Off: it is left out. The turns themselves are the same either way.

options.label: Flexible Sextant Use
options.effect: On: the sextant works by day or night, on the world map and inside surface towns. Off: only at night on the world map, as in the original. It never works in dungeons or the Underworld.

options.label: Ankh Visit Bonus
options.effect: An old players' tale says an Ankh draws Lord British to your camp; the original shows no sign of it. On: each living member wearing an Ankh makes his visit a little more likely. Off: the original odds.

options.label: Deed Experience
options.effect: Pay the whole party experience for quest deeds, once each. The original pays for kills only. None: no deed experience. Lean: a steady reward along the quest. Fuller: double Lean. Deeds already done are paid when this is turned on. Experience already paid is never topped up or taken back, so the game asks before applying a change. Default: Lean.

options.label: Share Kill Experience
options.effect: On: every living member shares a kill's experience equally. Off: it all goes to whoever struck the killing blow, as in the original. Default: Off.

options.label: Combat Speed
options.effect: Change how quickly combat actions and animations play. 1x is normal speed; higher values make combat faster.

options.label: Combat Key Repeat
options.effect: Hold a key in combat to repeat it, for every party member in turn. Measured repeats arrows and Tab about 6 times a second; Fast also repeats A, up to 10, 20 or 30 times a second. Default: Measured.

options.label: Combat Panels
options.effect: Choose what is drawn left of the battlefield. Order + Report shows Turn Order above the Battle Report. Turn Order only and Off send battle messages to the message window. Default: Order + Report.

options.label: Confirm Quick Save
options.effect: On: Q asks before it saves, and Ctrl+Q before it loads. Off: Q saves and Ctrl+Q loads at once. Either way they use the slot you last saved or loaded. Default: On.

options.label: Show Combat HP Bars
options.effect: Show a health bar under each injured figure in combat. Off hides the bars and adds injury descriptions to the battle report. Default: On.

options.label: Battle Frame
options.effect: Frame the battlefield: red while the battle is undecided, blue once it is won. Off draws no frame. Default: On.

options.label: Battle Experience
options.effect: List the experience each party member earned in the Battle complete summary. Off: the summary lists only what was collected. Default: On.

options.label: Maximum Action Popups
options.effect: Choose how many action messages can appear over the map at once. Off hides them; messages still appear in the lower-right text area.

options.label: Simple Notes Mode
options.effect: On: the Journal shows only My Notes. Off: every tab. Nothing is deleted. Default: Off.

credits.title: Bundled art, sound and fonts

credits.title: The original game
